# Industrial Contractors Insurance

> Industrial Contractors Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides commercial insurance for this trade in all 50 states. Coverage lines: General Liability Insurance for Heavy Industrial Contractors, Professional Liability (E&O) for Heavy Industrial Contractors, Workers' Compensation for Heavy Industrial Contractors, Commercial Auto for Heavy Industrial Contractors, Umbrella / Excess Liability for Heavy Industrial Contractors, Contractors Pollution Liability for Heavy Industrial Contractors, Inland Marine / Equipment Floater for Heavy Industrial Contractors, Builders Risk / Installation Floater for Heavy Industrial Contractors. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
